candidates.change_summary: Replace the initialization check to require that intitalized is true instead of reverting when true, so SetMinSum only succeeds if already initialized.
Invert the condition: only allow setting MinSum when not initialized (explicit require instead of revert), identical effect but different statement form.
Remove the initialization guard entirely so MinSum can always be changed.
Insert an unconditional revert after setting MinSum so the call always reverts and MinSum does not change externally.
Change assignment to add the provided value to MinSum instead of overwriting it.
